name: Frisco Family Services Food Pantry
operatingHours: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM | Wed: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
description: Full-service food pantry providing fresh produce, staples, meats, dairy, infant formula, and household hygiene packages to families in crisis.

name: Grace Avenue Community Table
description: Free, warm, nutritious dine-in community meals served with hospitality and dignity. No ID or verification required. Takeaway snack packs available.

name: North Texas Food Bank Mobile Drop (Frisco)
description: Bulk pantry distribution box handoff. Provides 40-50 lbs of nutritious shelf-stable items, fresh produce, and milk boxes directly to vehicles or walk-ups.

name: Frisco Public Library Hydration Station
operatingHours: Mon-Thu: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM | Fri-Sat: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM | Sun: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM
description: Chilled filtered bottle refilling stations on all levels. Serves as an official municipal cooling center with public restrooms, charging stations, and Wi-Fi.

name: Frisco Commons Water Refill Point
description: Public outdoor drinking water fountains and bottle filling points located under shaded pavilions with accessible emergency call posts.

name: The Grove Senior & Community Respite
description: Designated daytime cooling and hydration center with complimentary bottled water, resting areas, and social services navigator assistance.

name: Frisco Resale & Voucher Assistance
description: Voucher-based emergency clothing distribution providing work apparel, winter coats, new underwear, children's clothes, and sturdy shoes for individuals in crisis.

name: Cornerstone Community Closet Frisco
description: Clean seasonal apparel, school clothes for youth, infant supplies, clean socks, and emergency blankets distributed without cost.

name: Treasured Vessels Emergency Wardrobe
description: Emergency dignity packs, essential apparel sets, sneakers, and personal hygiene kits for at-risk youth and adults in immediate crisis or fleeing hostile environments.

name: Frisco Family Services Transitional Office
description: Emergency housing intake, rapid re-housing navigation, temporary emergency motel vouchers for families with children during severe weather events.

name: Collin County Homeless Coalition Intake
description: Coordinated Entry point for regional emergency shelter beds, severe freeze warming relief, and case-managed supportive housing referrals.

name: Hope's Door New Beginning Safe Shelter
operatingHours: 24 Hours / 7 Days a Week Emergency Intake
description: Confidential emergency shelter, 24/7 crisis intervention, and safe refuge for individuals and families escaping domestic abuse, intimate partner violence, or trafficking.
